subtitles.en: It's time now for a moment of interest. A pair of Blue Al private credit funds hit with the industry's largest redemption requests totaling $4.7 billion. And that has
subtitles.zh: 现在是关注时刻。Blue Owl的两只私募信贷基金遭遇行业最大赎回请求，总额达47亿美元。

subtitles.en: forced Blue Al to cap withdrawals for a second straight quarter. Joining us now is Shanaid Cruz, a senior editor and author of the twice-weekly going private newsletter. So
subtitles.zh: 这迫使Blue Owl连续第二个季度限制赎回。我们邀请到Shanaid Cruz，她是资深编辑，也是每周两期的Going Private通讯作者。

subtitles.en: Shanaid, which specific funds are these? Are they the large ones or are they smaller ones? Just give us some context here.
subtitles.zh: Shanaid，具体是哪几只基金？是大基金还是小基金？请给我们一些背景。

subtitles.en: Sure. Yeah. Well, the numbers from Blue Al capital certainly got people talking this morning. It is one of their larger funds and a smaller fund, indeed, as well.
subtitles.zh: 好的。Blue Owl的数据今早引发热议。确实涉及一只大基金和一只小基金。
en_highlights: larger funds and a smaller fund

subtitles.en: The first of all, the Blue Al credit income core, the larger of the funds saw a smaller redemption request from compared
subtitles.zh: 首先，Blue Owl信贷收益核心基金（较大那只）的赎回请求较上季度有所减少。

subtitles.en: with last quarter. The same with their smaller Blue Al technology income core also had a number of requests to exit
subtitles.zh: 同样，较小的Blue Owl科技收益核心基金也收到不少退出请求。

subtitles.en: that fund. They're both exposed in a way to software, which is one of the one of the key concerns of private credit investors
subtitles.zh: 两只基金都涉及软件领域，这是当前私募信贷市场参与者关注的关键问题之一。

subtitles.en: at the moment. Yeah, that makes a lot of sense. So it feels like a lot of this is spill over from the first quarter when they had to gate the fund and couldn't fulfill all the redemption
subtitles.zh: 有道理。所以这似乎是第一季度的延续，当时他们不得不限制赎回，无法满足所有请求。对吗？
en_highlights: spill over from the first quarter

subtitles.en: requests. Is that right? Yeah, that's right. But as we say, that the numbers look quite bad, but if you take a closer look,
subtitles.zh: 是的。但数字看起来糟糕，仔细看仍有乐观理由：恐慌可能开始消退。

subtitles.en: there are still reasons to be optimistic that maybe the panic might be starting to subside, that the larger of the funds
subtitles.zh: 较大基金的赎回请求规模实际上在下降。
